{{Quote|Had a second cousin once named Shirley. Tried that wintenberry stuff you're haulin'. Broke down with the gallopin' gosharooties. Too many trace minerals for a fourth-generation colonist. We gotta watch what we eat, us Dilonexicans, that's a fact.|[[Bernie]], to [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref>}}
The '''Dilonexicans''' were the inhabitants of [[Dilonexa XXIII]], an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]], and the only habitable [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Dilonexa system/Legends|Dilonexa system]].

As Dilonexa XXIII was deficient in heavy metals, the populace developed an [[Allergy/Legends|allergic reaction]] to [[Foodstuff/Legends|foods]] that contained too many trace metals in them.
